stories.title: Previsão do tempo hoje para Brasília (DF): sol com algumas nuvens; não chove

en.title: Weather forecast today for Brasília (DF): sun with some clouds; no rain
en.summary: Brasília is expected to experience sunny conditions with some clouds on Tuesday the 22nd, with no precipitation. High temperatures will reach 33°C and lows of 22°C.

stories.title: Previsão do tempo hoje para São Paulo (SP): sol com algumas nuvens; chove rápido durante o dia e à noite

en.title: Weather forecast today for São Paulo (SP): sun with some clouds; quick rain during the day and at night
en.summary: São Paulo will see sunny periods with some clouds on Tuesday the 22nd, accompanied by brief rainfall during daytime and nighttime hours. Maximum temperatures reach 23°C with minimums of 17°C.

en.summary: São Bernardo do Campo will experience sunny conditions with considerable cloud cover on Tuesday the 22nd, with rain showers expected in the afternoon and evening. Highs of 23°C and lows of 18°C are anticipated.

stories.title: 'Ninguém conseguiu contato', diz primo de Rick após helicóptero com o cantor desaparecer

en.title: "No one could contact him", says cousin of Rick after helicopter with singer goes missing
en.summary: A helicopter carrying singer Rick from the duo Rick and Renner disappeared in Santa Catarina on Monday. Rescue teams from firefighters, military police, and the Brazilian Air Force are searching the Urubici region while the singer's family reports unsuccessful attempts to contact him.

stories.title: Helicóptero desaparecido com Rick leva até sete pessoas e custa cerca de R$ 10 milhões

en.title: Missing helicopter with Rick carries up to seven people and costs around 10 million reais
en.summary: A Bell 430 helicopter that disappeared with singer Rick from the duo Rick and Renner in Santa Catarina can carry up to seven passengers and is valued at approximately 10 million reais on the international market.

stories.title: Quem é Bruno Avelar, amigo de Neymar que estava em voo que sumiu com cantor Rick

en.title: Who is Bruno Avelar, Neymar's friend who was on flight that disappeared with singer Rick
en.summary: Entrepreneur, speaker and writer Bruno Avelar, 41, was among the occupants of the helicopter that disappeared after departing from Porto Belo in Santa Catarina. The aircraft also carried singer Rick, a videographer and the pilot.

stories.title: FAB e bombeiros buscam helicóptero com cantor Rick, desaparecido em SC

en.title: Brazilian Air Force and firefighters search for helicopter with singer Rick, missing in SC
en.summary: The Brazilian Air Force and Santa Catarina firefighters are searching for helicopter PP-MGR that disappeared on Monday afternoon near São Joaquim. The aircraft departed from Porto Belo and was carrying singer Rick from the duo Rick and Renner, along with entrepreneur Bruno Avelar.

stories.title: FAB busca helicóptero desaparecido em SC; cantor Rick, dupla com Renner, estava na aeronave

en.title: Brazilian Air Force searches for helicopter missing in SC; singer Rick, duo with Renner, was on the aircraft
en.summary: The Brazilian Air Force is searching for a helicopter that disappeared in Santa Catarina with singer Rick from the duo Rick and Renner on board.

stories.title: UPDATE 1: Antes da Assembleia da ONU, Lula se reúne com líderes de esquerda e debate extremismo

en.title: UPDATE 1: Before UN Assembly, Lula meets with left-wing leaders and discusses extremism
en.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held meetings with left and center-left leaders on the first day of his New York agenda, ahead of the UN General Assembly opening.

stories.title: Descobertas globais de petróleo e gás atingem mínima de 40 anos devido a cortes de investimentos

en.title: Global oil and gas discoveries reach 40-year low due to investment cuts
en.summary: Worldwide discoveries of oil and gas fields fell to their lowest level in over four decades in 2025, with only 19 commercially significant finds recorded, as energy companies reduced exploration investments.

stories.title: A IA tem sede de gigawatts: o Brasil está pronto para a conta?

en.title: AI has a gigawatt thirst: is Brazil ready for the bill?
en.summary: Global electricity consumption by data centers is projected to more than double by 2030 due to artificial intelligence demands, raising questions about Brazil's capacity to meet this massive and continuous energy need.

stories.title: AGU entra com ação no STF pedindo perda de cargo para juiz do STJ acusado de assédio sexual

en.title: Attorney General's Office files suit in Supreme Court seeking removal of STJ judge accused of sexual harassment
en.summary: Brazil's Attorney General's Office filed a civil action in the Supreme Court to remove a Superior Court of Justice minister accused of sexual harassment and improper conduct from his position.

stories.title: Após banir imprensa, Casa Branca lança 'Trump TV' com elogios e destaques da gestão do presidente dos EUA

en.title: After banning press, White House launches 'Trump TV' with praise and highlights of US president's administration
en.summary: The Trump administration launched a 'Trump TV' channel on the White House YouTube to broadcast favorable content about the president, following the ban of critical outlets including CNN and MSNBC from Executive coverage.
